breakfast.name: Zucchini Quiche Appetizers
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Grease bottom and sides of rectangular pan 13 x 9 x
Stir together all ingredients; spread in pan.
Bake about 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Cut into 2" squares.
Cut squares diagonally in half into triangles.

lunch.name: How to Make an Amazing Chicken Salad with Apples and Celery
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups Rotisserie chicken cut and cubed
2 tbsp reduced fat mayo with olive oil
1 cup chopped apples I use 2 granny smith apples
steps: Mix chicken, celery, and apples.
In a separate bowl mix mayo, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Mix well.
Combine chicken mixture with mayo mixture and stir well.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
OPTIONAL: Slice an avocado, remove the pit, and serve the chicken salad with avocado. It's so good!

dinner.name: Easy Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts cut into bite size cubes
4 tablespoons of vegetable oil or grape seed oil
1 small container plain yogurt (about ½ cup)
steps: In a small bowl mix all the spices including the ginger. Set aside.
In a large saucepan, heat the oil .
Add the onions and cook until golden brown.
Add the garlic and continue to cook for a minute.
Stir in the spices and allow the flavours to infuse.
Stir in the tomato paste.
Add the chopped tomato and pour in the water. Simmer and season with salt to taste.
Add the chicken pieces stirring well to coat the meat with the sauce. Continue to simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce has thickened, about 12 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt and continue to simmer 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro
Serve with bismati rice.
